Finnish

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Internationalism (see English stenography).

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ˈstenoˌɡrɑfiɑ/, [ˈs̠te̞no̞ˌɡrɑ̝fiɑ̝]
  • Rhymes: -ɑfiɑ
  • Syllabification(key): ste‧no‧gra‧fi‧a, ste‧nog‧ra‧fi‧a
  • Hyphenation(key): steno‧grafia, ste‧nog‧ra‧fia

Noun

[edit]

stenografia

  1. stenography

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From steno- +‎ -grafia.

Noun

[edit]

stenografia f (plural stenografie)

  1. shorthand
  2. stenography

Related terms

[edit]
  • stenografare
